target.title: fix(telegram): harden rich send fallback and typing breaker
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

This PR fixes the two Telegram reliability gaps that still remain from #99471 on current `main`:

- Typing indicators stop after only two consecutive `start()` failures by default. That is too aggressive for transient Telegram `sendChatAction` failures and can make a still-running reply look silent.
- Telegram rich-message send funnels can still send an empty rendered rich payload, or receive `400: RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`, without entering the same plain-text fallback path used for existing rich validation failures. In chunked durable sends, that can abort delivery before later valid chunks are sent.

The rich-message reply-context extraction part of #99471 is already fixed on current `main`; this PR intentionally leaves that path unchanged and focuses on the remaining typing and rich-send behavior.

Closes #99471

## Summary

- Raise the default typing-start breaker from 2 to 5 consecutive failures while keeping explicit overrides and success-reset behavior intact.
- Add a shared rich-message fallback predicate for both `RICH_MESSAGE_*_INVALID` and `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`.
- Guard empty rendered rich-message payloads before calling Telegram `sendRichMessage`.
- Keep durable and streaming Telegram send funnels aligned:
  - `extensions/telegram/src/send.ts`
  - `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts`
- Add regression tests for the typing threshold and both rich-message fallback paths.

## Evidence

Local lightweight prechecks on the updated branch:

- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/channels/typing.ts src/channels/typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/send-error-predicates.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` — passed
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD -- src/channels/typing.ts src/channels/typing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/send-error-predicates.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.ts extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.send.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` — passed

Regression coverage added in this PR:

- `src/channels/typing.test.ts` now verifies the default breaker continues through five consecutive start failures before stopping.
- `extensions/telegram/src/send.test.ts` now verifies durable rich sends fall back to plain text on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`.
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` now verifies delivery rich sends fall back to plain text on `RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED`.
- `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts` now verifies empty rich text is rejected before calling raw `sendRichMessage`.

CI is running on the updated branch after rebasing onto current `main`. The previous CI failure was caused by a local helper being scoped inside the plain send chunk function; the helper has been moved into the rich send chunk function and the stale typing assertion has been updated.

Live Telegram Desktop proof is not claimed here because this fix is for Telegram Bot API rejection handling (`RICH_MESSAGE_CONTENT_REQUIRED` / empty rich payload), and that rejection condition cannot be reproduced safely as a normal user-visible Telegram Desktop interaction. The added unit coverage exercises the exact Bot API error and fallback behavior directly.

## Risk

Low to moderate:

- Typing feedback may retry longer during transient channel typing failures, but still stops after a bounded number of consecutive failures.
- Rich-message fallback only catches Telegram rich validation/content-required errors; unrelated send failures still propagate.
- Empty rich chunks without sendable plain text are skipped in the durable rich chunk loop so later valid chunks can still deliver.
